READ: Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin says President Marcos is "dismayed" by reports that government personnel are putting up SONA-related materials in public areas while many communities are battling heavy flooding due to rains brought by southwest monsoon.

Bersamin: "Let me be clear: all SONA-related preparations are hereby ordered immediately suspended. The Department of Public Works and Highways, along with all concerned agencies, must put full attention and exclusive focus on flood response and relief operations."

Bersamin: "The President's directive is to focus all efforts on ensuring the safety and welfare of the Filipino people, especially during times of crisis. All government agencies are expected to act accordingly."

The statement came after Malacañang received reports that DPWH personnel were installing tarpaulins of the President for his SONA along roads in Manila. President Marcos is set to deliver his 4th SONA on July 28. | @dexcabalzaINQ

data.text:
After Ondoy I kept saying that the Wawa Dam should be revived as a water impounding facility for Metro Manila. 

Now that it's operating, it's controlled the flow of water from the Sierra Madre to the point that even if the Marikina River overflows, it doesn't inundate the surrounding communities. 

Even if the water rose to 18 meters, there was no widespread flooding unlike before. It also helped that the rains weren't continuous.

SANA 'WAG NA PONG UMULAN 🙏

As of 11:33 AM on Tuesday, the water level in the Marikina River subsided but remained at a critical 16 meters, placing it under the second alarm.

Monsoon rains continue to pour, and forced evacuations are still being implemented in low-lying areas as a precautionary measure. Residents are advised to remain alert and follow local advisories.

As of 11 AM today, July 22, 2025, PAGASA raised an orange warning level over Metro Manila, indicating a threat of flooding in some areas.
